content_sections.heading: About District Collector Office, Jangaon
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Collector & District Magistrate, Jangaon District, has issued this notification for staff at 8 Telangana Model Schools (TGMS) in the district. The engagement follows the orders and instructions of the School Education Department, Government of Telangana.

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: Art Teacher: Teaching drawing, painting, sketching and other visual arts, encouraging creativity and preparing students for art competitions and exhibitions. Yoga Teacher: Conducting yoga classes, teaching asanas, pranayama and meditation, and promoting physical and mental well-being among students. Computer Teacher: Teaching computer education, conducting practical and theory classes, maintaining computer laboratories and promoting digital literacy. Librarian: Maintaining library books and records, cataloguing and classifying books, assisting students and staff in accessing library resources and managing library activities.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A merit list will be prepared for each category based on the marks obtained in the written exam and/or interview. It will be displayed on the Jangaon District website. Exam venue: Main Conference Hall, IDOC Complex, Collectorate, Jangaon District. What to bring: Any valid identity proof, a black or blue ball point pen and an exam pad only. Medical test: Mandatory for every candidate attending the examination. The DM&HO, Jangaon, conducts it in the premises of the IDOC, Jangaon. Certificate verification: All relevant original certificates relating to educational qualifications, age and other eligibility conditions shall be verified before engagement.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement runs from 9 November 2026 to 31 March 2027, or until the actual requirement ceases to exist, whichever is earlier. It is purely on an outsourcing basis and confers no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption in Government service. Engagement will be made through the existing outsourcing agency or a new outsourcing agency, as appropriate. Remuneration shall be paid as prescribed by the Government, subject to applicable rules and instructions. Selected personnel work under the administrative control of the concerned Telangana Model School Headmaster/Principal and discharge the duties assigned to them. The District Collector, Jangaon, reserves the right to cancel or modify the notification in accordance with Government instructions and administrative requirements.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts does each school have?
faq.answer: Each of the 8 Telangana Model Schools has 4 posts: 1 Art Teacher, 1 Yoga Teacher, 1 Computer Teacher and 1 Librarian.

faq.question: Q2. Which degrees are accepted for Computer Teacher?
faq.answer: The notice accepts a Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, B.Tech / B.E, MCA, BCA, B.Sc. Computers or B.Com. (Computers).

faq.question: Q3. Can a B.P.Ed. holder apply for Yoga Teacher?
faq.answer: Yes, if the B.P.Ed. has Yoga specialization. Graduation with a Diploma in Yoga, or a Degree in Yoga, is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. It is an outsourcing engagement that gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption, and it runs no later than 31 March 2027.

faq.question: Q5. Where do I hand in the Resume / Bio-Data Form?
faq.answer: Room No - F27 on the first floor of the Collectorate, Jangaon District, which is where the notice places the District Education Office.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a medical test?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice makes it mandatory for every candidate attending the examination, and the DM&HO, Jangaon, conducts it at the IDOC premises.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the merit list appear?
faq.answer: A separate merit list for each category will be displayed on the Jangaon District website.

faq.question: Q8. Which caste and residence papers are needed?
faq.answer: You need the latest Caste Certificates from the Tashildar / MRO concerned. Candidates who studied privately also need a residency certificate from the same office.
